translation:
<ins>Moutan Bark Powder (牡丹皮散)</ins>
Moutan bark (牡丹皮), dang gui (當歸), drynaria (骨碎補), safflower (紅花, soaked in wine), dipsacus (續斷), frankincense (乳香), myrrh (沒藥), peach kernel (桃仁), chuanxiong (川芎), red peony (赤芍藥), raw rehmannia (生地黃, each equal parts)
Above, decoct in water and wine and take; then use hot cooked glutinous rice (秫米) to wrap and bind warmly; when it becomes cold, steam it hot again and change the binding. <ins>Tangerine and Atractylodes Four Substances Decoction (橘術四物湯)</ins>
Dang gui (當歸), chuanxiong (川芎), white peony (白芍藥), Huaiqing raw rehmannia (懷慶生地, each two qian), tangerine peel (陳皮), atractylodes (白朮), safflower (紅花, each one qian), peach kernel (桃仁, ten)
Above, decoct with raw rehmannia (生地黃) and take. For bone and joint pain, add notopterygium (羌活) and duhuo (獨活).
